# Mechanism exposures

The callable APIs the hardcores register with the exposed-API registry. A participant reaches each one with `registry.resolve(name)`; a caged participant reaches it through the cage's `resolve`. Scope: `kernel` admits kernel origin; `runtime` admits kernel and runtime; `host` admits host; `any` admits all.

| Exposure | Scope | Policy | Hardcore |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `syntax.parse@1` | `any` | none | `brud.core.parser` |
| `syntax.route@1` | `any` | none | `brud.core.router` |
| `events.emit@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.events` |
| `events.pull@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.events` |
| `events.close@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.events` |
| `events.list@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.events` |
| `events.subscribe@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.events` |
| `interception.evaluate@1` | `any` | none | `brud.core.interception` |
| `interception.list@1` | `runtime` | none | `brud.core.interception` |
